Project.NAME: marktext-modernized
Project.keywords: markdown, editor, wysiwyg, electron, tauri, vue3, muya, macos, homebrew, port, modernization
Project.annotation: Phase-A (Electron 30 + Vue 3) and Phase-B (Tauri v2 + Rust) module graph. Phase-A retains upstream structure (src/main, src/renderer, src/muya, src/common) and is represented only by muya (M-012) and renderer (M-011) here. Phase-B introduces Rust backend modules M-001..M-010 plus the IPC bridge M-013.

M-001.NAME: mt-tauri-shell
M-001.purpose: Tauri app entrypoint; builds app, registers plugins, manages windows and lifecycle.

fn-main.PURPOSE: Boot Tauri app with single-instance guard and wired modules

M-002.NAME: mt-fs-commands
M-002.purpose: Filesystem IPC commands (read, write, stat, rename, delete) with sandbox guard from M-010.

fn-fs_read.PURPOSE: Read UTF-8 file after sandbox check

M-003.NAME: mt-fs-watcher
M-003.purpose: Filesystem watcher via `notify` crate with 200ms debounce; emits change events to renderer.

M-004.NAME: mt-search
M-004.purpose: Streaming text search via `grep-searcher` crate; honors .gitignore.

fn-search_run.PURPOSE: Stream search results with cancellation token

M-005.NAME: mt-prefs
M-005.purpose: Persistent preferences via tauri-plugin-store with legacy electron-store migration.

fn-prefs_set.PURPOSE: Write a pref key (emits change event)

M-006.NAME: mt-shortcuts
M-006.purpose: Global/local keyboard shortcut registration and dispatch (accelerator parser honors capitalized modifiers per #4134).

M-007.NAME: mt-spell
M-007.purpose: Spellcheck through the WebView's native spellchecker + bundled hunspell dictionaries for extra languages; thin shim over tauri-plugin-spellcheck if available or manual session config.

fn-spell_suggest.PURPOSE: Get suggestions from OS spell checker

M-008.NAME: mt-fonts
M-008.purpose: System font enumeration via `font-kit`; per-session cache.

M-009.NAME: mt-menu
M-009.purpose: Native menu bar and context menus; dispatches command IDs to renderer.

fn-menu_dispatch.PURPOSE: Emit MenuInvoked event to focused window

type-MenuSpec.PURPOSE: Declarative menu structure with command IDs

M-010.NAME: mt-security
M-010.purpose: Path sandbox, URL whitelist, HTML sanitization, and shell.open confirmation gating (fixes CVE-2023-2318 #3621 and #4177).

fn-sec_confirm_shell_open.PURPOSE: Prompt user before external shell invocation

M-011.NAME: mt-renderer
M-011.purpose: Vue 3 renderer app (migrated in Phase A via PR #4001); hosts muya, theme controller, command dispatcher.

fn-mountApp.PURPOSE: Bootstrap Vue app and mount muya

M-012.NAME: muya
M-012.purpose: WYSIWYG Markdown engine (existing, zero Electron coupling, ports to WebView as is).

fn-getMarkdown.PURPOSE: Export current editor state as markdown

M-014.NAME: mt-encoding
M-014.purpose: Text encoding detection + conversion + line-ending normalization; replaces upstream ced + iconv-lite.

M-015.NAME: mt-pandoc-bridge
M-015.purpose: Import docx/odt/latex/rst/etc. → Markdown via pandoc subprocess with macOS /Library/TeX/texbin PATH patching.

fn-pandoc_available.PURPOSE: Probe pandoc on PATH with MARKTEXT_PANDOC override

fn-pandoc_import.PURPOSE: Spawn pandoc; pipe stdio; return markdown

M-016.NAME: mt-updater
M-016.purpose: Manual-download auto-update via tauri-plugin-updater; feeds from xronocode/mark releases.

M-017.NAME: mt-recent-docs
M-017.purpose: Recently-used documents list (max 12) with OS integration (macOS Dock, Windows Jump List, Linux JSON).

M-018.NAME: mt-screenshot
M-018.purpose: macOS-only screenshot capture via `screencapture -i -c`; clipboard PNG → workspace file.

fn-screenshot_capture.PURPOSE: Spawn screencapture; read clipboard; write PNG; return path

M-019.NAME: mt-datacenter
M-019.purpose: User image history, ImageBed config, and secrets (GitHub token) via keychain; legacy serviceName migration marktext → com.xronocode.mark.

M-020.NAME: mt-cli-flags
M-020.purpose: Parse CLI args --safe, --user-data-dir, --debug, --new-window, --disable-gpu, --disable-spellcheck, plus portable-mode auto-detect.

fn-parse_argv.PURPOSE: Parse; exit with usage on error

M-013.NAME: mt-ipc-bridge
M-013.purpose: Frontend wrapper over Tauri invoke/listen that mirrors Electron-era ipcRenderer surface for port-unchanged renderer code.

export-ipc.PURPOSE: Facade: ipc.fs / ipc.search / ipc.prefs / ipc.shortcuts / ipc.spell / ipc.fonts

M-901.NAME: grace-context-hygiene-policy
M-901.purpose: GRACE-compatible AI Standards token/session hygiene overlay with context modes, precedence rules, and escalation triggers.

fn-select_context_mode.PURPOSE: Choose targeted, wave, or full context

fn-enforce_precedence.PURPOSE: Protect correctness, verification, and graph consistency above context economy

M-902.NAME: grace-packet-context-budget
M-902.purpose: Operational packet context-budget fields that make loaded/skipped context and risk explicit.

fn-build_execution_packet.PURPOSE: Attach context-policy, loaded/skipped artifacts, and verification-not-skipped fields

fn-validate_packet_hygiene.PURPOSE: Reject hidden context risk or silent verification skips

M-903.NAME: grace-session-handoff
M-903.purpose: Durable handoff policy for compaction, agent rotation, and paused execution.

fn-write_handoff.PURPOSE: Record task, decisions, changed files, blockers, verification status, and next action

fn-resume_from_handoff.PURPOSE: Continue from durable context before opening broad artifacts

M-904.NAME: grace-skill-scope-rules
M-904.purpose: Skill-specific context defaults and escalation rules for GRACE planning, execution, review, verification, refresh, and multiagent execution.

fn-resolve_skill_scope.PURPOSE: Return default and escalation context mode for a GRACE skill

fn-check_scope_override.PURPOSE: Require explicit reason when lower context is used under risk

M-905.NAME: grace-context-verification
M-905.purpose: Verification gates proving context hygiene did not suppress required tests, log markers, or review scope.

fn-verify_context_gate.PURPOSE: Assert required verification is present or an explicit blocker is recorded

M-906.NAME: grace-knowledge-graph-hygiene
M-906.purpose: Knowledge graph representation for hygiene modules while preserving a runtime-scope-boundary from product modules.

fn-check_runtime_boundary.PURPOSE: Ensure M-901..M-906 do not become runtime dependencies of M-001..M-020
